Bacopa Monnieri Powder Bulk from Tradenest Naturals

Brahmi leaf powder is the dried, ground leaf of Bacopa monnieri, a herb traditionally used in Ayurvedic and herbal formulations. Tradenest Naturals supplies bacopa monnieri powder bulk to supplement, herbal tea and cosmetic brands around the world. The leaves are dehydrated and milled to a fine, even powder. Many buyers ask for brahmi powder 100 mesh for smooth formulations, and our standard 80-100 mesh grade is made for that use. As a brahmi leaf powder supplier India, we buy raw leaves that are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. This helps us keep colour, aroma and texture steady from batch to batch.

Processing Excellence

Our production follows documented hygiene practices. We first sort the leaves and remove stems and foreign matter. The leaves are then cleaned and dehydrated at controlled temperatures. Finally, they are milled and sieved to a fine powder. As a brahmi leaf powder exporter, we add nothing to the standard grade. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Brands buying wholesale brahmi leaf powder can order anything from trial lots to regular bulk volumes. Each batch is checked for moisture and mesh before packing. Our bulk brahmi powder supply service also includes OEM and private label packing.

Quality Standards and Specifications

Buyers often ask about the pure brahmi leaf powder price and specifications. We quote clearly for trial and bulk orders, with an MOQ of 5 Kg. The powder is dehydrated and milled to 80-100 mesh. Moisture is 7.0% or less, which limits clumping. Shelf life is 24 months. B2B brahmi powder suppliers and brands value our clear paperwork and batch traceability.

Applications and Industry Uses

Brahmi powder is used in several sectors. Supplement companies use it in capsules and tablets. Herbal tea brands blend it into herbal infusions. Cosmetic brands add it to hair masks and hair oils. It is also used in traditional Ayurvedic formulations.

Buyer Value and Partnership

Tradenest Naturals offers flexible packaging, samples on request and export documentation support. We ship worldwide from India and aim for long-term supply relationships. Contact our team to request a quote or a product sample.
